Windows and doors

Casing style and window lites: Style → Windows and doors, or click a window or door in the plan.

Drag one onto a wall in the plan, or click to add it to the selected wall. Drag a window or door in the plan to move it, onto another wall too; click one and press Delete to remove it.

“From left” is measured from the left end of the wall as you stand in the room facing it, to the edge of the rough opening.

Job settings

Every cabinet follows these unless it sets its own under its Order details.

Islands

An island is a run of base cabinets standing on its own, one side or two back to back, with finished end panels and one countertop over it. Drag it in the plan to move it. Drop more base cabinets onto either side, or use Fill with cabinets.

Add cabinets

Or use Cabinets and Appliances in the menu over the view. Drag one onto a wall in the 3D view or the plan, or click it to add it to the first open space on the chosen wall. Resize it once it’s placed.

Furniture

Tables, chairs and stools to show the room in use (not Keystone products). Drag one into the room, in the plan or the 3D view; tables bring their chairs, leaving out any that a wall or a built-in bench is in the way of.

Countertop accessories

Accessories scale with the open countertop, about one for every 3 1/2 feet, so a short counter only gets one or two. Evening and night make the cabinet lighting stand out. Use Render photo to see it all with real shadows and reflections.

Colors, wood grain, finishes and shapes are shown for planning purposes. Screens and lighting vary, so what you see may differ from the finished product. Please confirm material and finish selections with physical samples before ordering.

Design cabinets for me

This lays out cabinets on the empty walls you choose, around the windows and doors you drew. Everything already in the project stays as it is: walls that have cabinets keep them, and a refrigerator, range, sink base or dishwasher you’ve placed on a chosen wall stays where it is, with the rest laid out around it. Undo takes it back.

Which walls get cabinets?

Click the walls in the room to choose them. Windows and doors are shown so you can tell which is which.
